overview: The Medford Water and Sewer Commission reviewed customer billing and abatement appeals, denied an irrigation meter request for a condominium complex, and postponed setting FY24 water and sewer rates pending City Council action on retained earnings.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the prior meeting.

items.title: Petition 1725: 65 Ashland Street High Bill Appeal
items.summary: Residents disputed a $3,120 bill attributed to a leak and agreed to have their removed water meter tested for accuracy by a third party.

items.title: Petition 1742: Freeze-Related Water and Sewer Abatement Request
items.summary: Approved a motion to reduce the sewer portion of a nearly $16,000 burst-pipe bill by 50 percent, conditional on the homeowner submitting documentation of fixed-income retiree hardship.

items.title: Petition: Irrigation Meter Request for Wellington Woods
items.summary: Denied an application for an irrigation meter for a 200-unit condominium development because city regulations restrict secondary irrigation meters to residential properties up to three units.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2024 Water and Sewer Rates
items.summary: Voted to postpone setting water and sewer rates until the City Council decides whether to approve the mayor's proposed $500,000 transfer from retained earnings.

items.title: Review of Erratic Usage at 45 Coolidge Road
items.summary: Staff reviewed an estimated billing issue stemming from a failing reading device and access delays, calculating adjustments based on new meter data.
